rectangle.reproduction: 70 × 210 mm paper, rectangle, 0.4 mm thickness, perspective view
rectangle.cause: Zero-radius quadratic corner curves generate nearly coincident floating-point samples. Earcut omitted half the front face.
rectangle.fix: Use exactly four straight edges for a rectangle.
rectangle.unitCoverage: Both front and back cover all area with two nondegenerate triangles at 70×210, 100×148, 5×5, 5×500 and 500×5 mm.
rectangle.browserCoverage: 70×210×0.4 and 5×15×0.05 mm, separate front/back color patterns, >98% colored interior, correct reading orientation and saved dimensions after reload.

badge.reproduction: 200 mm badge, warm scene, back view, 35 px horizontal / 12 px vertical orbit drag
badge.cause: The fixed 0.1–10000 camera frustum quantized a 0.024 mm disc/cap separation to less than one 24-bit depth-buffer step at the fitted distance.
badge.fix: Project the eight model-bounds corners into camera depth and fit near/far on rendering and PNG export, including after zoom and pan. Leave room for the outline guide and rear shadow plane.
badge.sample: Central flat patch above the pin; fraction of horizontal neighboring pixels with RGB absolute difference sum >6.
badge.browserAssertion: Fraction <0.01 after orbit and three zoom-out/zoom-in steps, plus 200 and 500 mm maximum-zoom closeups.
badge.unitCoverage: 5, 58, 200 and 500 mm envelopes through front/back/perspective, near/far zoom and panned target; former sub-pixel depth gap exceeds 100 depth steps, including maximum zoom for 58–500 mm models.
badge.closeupReview: A first spherical-bounds solution still collapsed near toward zero at maximum zoom. Verified the residual stripes at 500 mm and replaced the sphere with projected box depths; no zoom limits were tightened.

regressionCoverage: Existing acrylic reverse ink, white underbase, independent back layer and zero-opacity back layer checks passed.
limitation: Software WebGL browser verification; real device GPUs and manufacturer optical matching are not covered.
